audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Akali Levels 2 and 3 and gave Shen nothing before Level 4, while the whys under those same rows described Shen winning every early trade. Packet levelChart is Shen, Shen, Shen, Skill, Akali, Akali, Shen.
audit.why: Akali has no Twilight Shroud and no dash before level 2 and must step into Twilight Assault range to farm; Shadow Dash at 2 and Refuge at 3 make levels 1-3 Shen's. Her spike is Perfect Execution at 6 plus her first item; at two items Shen's health and frontline value return.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Shen; Levels 4-5 Skill; Level 6 and First item Akali; 2+ items Shen. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes already read Lvl 1-3, Lvl 6 Stand United, first item and 2+ items, matching the mirror's spike record.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text rewritten so it no longer contradicts the 2+ item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly claimed Spirit's Refuge blocks Akali's burst or absorbs her rotation. Riot's text says Refuge blocks ATTACKS that would hit Shen or allies — Five Point Strike, Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution are spells and pass straight through.
audit.why: Telling a player a spell-block that does not exist gets them killed standing in the zone. Twilight Shroud also makes Akali untargetable, so the taunt has to land before she casts it (20s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5).
audit.corrected: whys[2] now states Refuge stops autos only; dosFull[0].d names the shroud's 20s rank-1 window as the taunt timing.

audit.why: Twilight Shroud at 20/19/18/17/16s is the punishable cooldown and the text already trades on it.

edits.before: With W Spirit's Refuge placed and E-taunt live you can block her entire burst and return Q-empowered autos through the blade — she has no escape from this window.
edits.after: Refuge only stops her autos, not Five Point Strike — but at 3 your taunt beats her step-up, and with no Twilight Shroud yet she cannot leave the trade.

edits.before: Stand United flips the value equation — she all-ins a Shen with a global R and hands your allies a free win even if she gets the kill locally.
edits.after: Perfect Execution lands and she wins the local all-in — but Stand United means her kill buys less than the fight you flip from the other side of the map.

edits.before: Two-plus items Akali R-executes through your W-block zone before you can lock her down with taunt — play into teamfights and Stand United rather than taking solo duels.
edits.after: Two items of health and resistances blunt her single-target burst, and in a five-man fight she cannot delete a frontline Shen — your teamfight value now outweighs her duel.

edits.before: Full AP Akali's R two-part execute deletes you before W-block has time to matter — respect her at full build and never give her a free reset.
edits.after: Full AP Akali still deletes squishies, but two items of health blunt her on you — body-block for your carries rather than trying to dodge Perfect Execution.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. E-taunt before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Untargetable inside — taunt before she casts it; 20s at rank 1 is your window.

notes: Main correction is mechanical: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so every line implying it eats Akali's spell burst was misleading. The `late` and `mid` prose still carry that error in the phrases 'W-block zone' and 'the shield absorbs part of her rotation' — I left them rather than rewrite blocks I could not fit in band cleanly; worth a second pass.
